item.title: 🔥 BUSINESS CLASS DEAL! Fly from Italy to Singapore and Bangkok with lie-flat seats from €1,371 return
item.dc:creator: Maria Shvab
item.description: This is a seriously attractive premium-cabin fare to Southeast Asia. Gulf Air is offering Business Class flights from Milan and Rome to Singapore and Bangkok from €1371 return, with availability stretching from late 2026 into spring 2027. The journey connects through Bahrain, and unlike many cheaper “mixed-cabin” Business Class deals, these itineraries are scheduled with lie-flat seats on both sectors.

item.title: Business class flights to paradise! 🐠 From Paris to the Maldives from €1536 return
